sample_unit: posturographic X-ray images of severe single-curve scoliosis

links.outcome: General-purpose LLM accuracy on intended-use imaging tasks (scoliosis detection, Cobb angle) versus expert assessment
links.effect: ChatGPT detected scoliosis in 100% of images but Bing detected none; ChatGPT accurate for Cobb angle in only 43.5%, with limited accuracy for curve direction, type, and vertebral rotation.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT had limited effectiveness (43.5%) in assessing Cobb angles, showing significant inaccuracy and discrepancy compared to human assessments.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT and Microsoft Bing) on scoliosis detection and Cobb angle measurement from X-ray images without evaluating specific deployment safeguards or practices.
